text:
Wɔbɔɔ Atlanta aseɛ wɔ 1837 sɛ Terminus, Western & Atlantic Railroad line no awiei. Wɔsan too no Marthasville wɔ 1843 na afei Atlanta wɔ 1845, na efi saa railroad junction no mu na ɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ U.S. Southeast sikakorabea ne akwantu mfinimfini.

Kurow no abakɔsɛm kɔ American South no nkyerɛkyerɛmu mu. Ɛyɛ kurow a ɛho hia wɔ American Civil War mu, na wɔhyeɛ no wɔ Sherman 1864 campaign mu na wɔsan bɔɔ mu sɛ "New South" metropolis. Ɛyɛɛ civil rights movement mfinimfini – Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. awoɔbea ne ne base, a ne Southern Christian Leadership Conference ne Ebenezer Baptist Church wɔ "Sweet Auburn" na ɛhyɛɛ adwuma no mu. Wɔ 1996 mu no, kurow no hyɛɛ Summer Olympics, na ɛmaa ne din daa wiase.

Atlanta yɛ MLS soccer markets titiriw biako nso. Atlanta United FC, a wɔbɔɔ mu wɔ 2017, bɔɔ wɔ Mercedes-Benz Stadium na wɔadi MLS average attendance anim bere biara a ɛfiri wɔn debut. Klub no yɛɛ MLS Cup attendance record 73,019 wɔ 2018 MLS Cup a wɔn nkonim, na wɔbɔɔ raucous supporter culture a ɛwɔ groups te sɛ Footie Mob, La Doce ne All Stripes – a ɛmaa metro no Bleacher Report 2018 label sɛ "Black Soccer Capital of America."

Region no top-flight football pedigree trɛɛ ne klub no akyi. Metro no hyɛɛ 2024 Copa America opener, na ɛda so bɛhwɛ 2026 World Cup matches awotwe, a ɛka semi-final – beaeɛ a ɛfata ma kurow a ɛdan football kurow yɛɛ soccer capital.
